description:
I’ll never forget this moment with @tonyrobbins 🙏

Tony always comes into my life at the times I need him most. He’s seen me through ups and downs of business, relationships, personal goals, and more. 

This was the ultimate lesson I needed to learn before meeting my wife 💍 

It changed my perspective on relationships completely and gave me the wake-up call I needed to look within and start choosing myself and allowing love that was meant for me to find me. I am so lucky it brought me @marthahigareda ❤️

From the newest episode of Chasing Greatness - comment YES 🙌🎥

#Relationships #TonyRobbins #Love #MarthaHigareda #MindsetCoaching
transcript: Can I coach you directly as a friend? Please do. You got to stop finding what you're looking for in order to justify protecting yourself. 95% of success in a relationship is selection. It's not the selection you're thinking. It's not who you select. It's which part of yourself you select to bring to this relationship. And who primarily is the person who selects within themselves to be in relationship with you. You have to be able to go deeper. You got to be this kind of vulnerability that you're being with me right now, which I want to thank you for just as a friend. I'm a friend of yours even though we might only talk once every year and a half because I get who you are at a soulful level, not who you project. Who you project is a really great guy too, but I'm more interested in this guy I see right here because this guy will touch people's lives. This guy can have a level of fulfillment most people never have. The other guy will succeed. Success is getting what you want. Fulfillment is bringing what you're made for to those you love and those you've learned to love.
